perks.name: Resupply
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
perks.exact:
Scoring a kill spawns an Orb of Power that grants 1?% Super Energy, as well as +20% Special Ammo Progress and +20% Heavy Ammo Progress.
Incurs a 12 second cooldown before it can retrigger.

perks.name: From the Storm
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
perks.exact:
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

After having maintained a state of not dealing or receiving damage for at least 12 seconds:
Grants a stack of Frost Armor every 3 seconds.
Stacks up to x5 Frost Armor, refreshing its duration every 3 seconds.

Allies receive a copy of the Ammo Brick.

Enhanced Brick Chance is determined by the ally's Weapons Stat.

item.name: Harmonic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
